pythonFunction.name: get_modem_diagnostics
pythonFunction.description: Retrieves modem telemetry and area outage status for a Vodafone Ziggo customer in a single call. Returns modem ID, online status, signal strength, packet loss percentage, and whether there is a known area outage. Always call this before diagnosing or explaining any WiFi issue. Do not make assumptions about connection quality without calling this first.
